date.description: The bill's date: its tax point.

due_date.description: When it falls due; left out, the supplier's payment terms, else the organisation's (FR-ORG-04).

fx_rate.description: For a bill in another currency: base currency per one unit, as typed on the document. Left out, the bill takes the cascade's rate for its date (ENG-40).

input_tax.description: The facts its input tax is decided from (FR-AP-20). Left out, the usual: a tax invoice from a GST-registered supplier, addressed to the company.

kind.description: bill, the default, or vendor_credit: a supplier's credit note, entered as a bill is and posted as its reverse (FR-AP-03). Fixed once saved.

nature_of_payment.description: For a supplier resident outside Singapore (FR-AP-19): what the payment is for. Required to post such a bill (BILL-16); the tax agent's withholding decision is kept per supplier and nature. software_use is software bought for the company's own use, such as a subscription; movable_rent is rent of movable property.

supplier_id.description: The supplier: a contact marked as a vendor.

supplier_ref.description: The supplier's own number for the bill, as on their invoice.
